canonical_title: Minimum intensities in the horizontal plane of position lights

versions.title_at_revision: Minimum intensities in the horizontal plane of position lights
versions.text: Each position light intensity must equal or exceed the applicable values in the following table: Dihedral angle (light included) Angle from right or left of longitudinal axis measured from dead ahead Intensity (candelas) L and R ............... 0° to 10° ....... 40 (red and green) 10° to 20° ...... 30 20° to 110° ..... 5 A (rear white) …… 110° to 180° .... 20
